record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Aijeleth<WH0365> Shahar<WH07837>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> My God<WH0410>, my God<WH0410>, why hast thou forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> me? <FI>why art thou so<Fi> far<WH07350> from helping<WH03444> me, <FI>and from<Fi> the words<WH01697> of my roaring<WH07581>? <RF>Aijeleth...: or, the hind of the morning<Rf> <RF>helping...: Heb. my salvation<Rf>

O my God<WH0430>, I cry<WH07121><WTH8799> in the daytime<WH03119>, but thou hearest<WH06030><WTH8799> not; and in the night season<WH03915>, and am not silent<WH01747>. <RF>am...: Heb. there is no silence to me<Rf>
But thou <FI>art<Fi> holy<WH06918>, <FI>O thou<Fi> that inhabitest<WH03427><WTH8802> the praises<WH08416> of Israel<WH03478>.
Our fathers<WH01> trusted<WH0982><WTH8804> in thee: they trusted<WH0982><WTH8804>, and thou didst deliver<WH06403><WTH8762> them.
They cried<WH02199><WTH8804> unto thee, and were delivered<WH04422><WTH8738>: they trusted<WH0982><WTH8804> in thee, and were not confounded<WH0954><WTH8804>.
But I <FI>am<Fi> a worm<WH08438>, and no man<WH0376>; a reproach<WH02781> of men<WH0120>, and despised<WH0959><WTH8803> of the people<WH05971>.

All they that see<WH07200><WTH8802> me laugh me to scorn<WH03932><WTH8686>: they shoot out<WH06358><WTH8686> the lip<WH08193>, they shake<WH05128><WTH8686> the head<WH07218>, <FI>saying<Fi> , <RF>shoot...: Heb. open<Rf>

He trusted<WH01556><WTH8800> on the LORD<WH03068> <FI>that<Fi> he would deliver<WH06403><WTH8762> him: let him deliver<WH05337><WTH8686> him, seeing he delighted<WH02654><WTH8804> in him. <RF>He trusted...: Heb. He rolled himself on<Rf> <RF>seeing...: or, if he delight in<Rf>

But thou <FI>art<Fi> he that took<WH01518><WTH8801> me out of the womb<WH0990>: thou didst make me hope<WH0982><WTH8688> <FI>when I was<Fi> upon my mother's<WH0517> breasts<WH07699>. <RF>didst...: or, kept me in safety<Rf>
I was cast<WH07993><WTH8717> upon thee from the womb<WH07358>: thou <FI>art<Fi> my God<WH0410> from my mother's<WH0517> belly<WH0990>.<CM>
Be not far<WH07368><WTH8799> from me; for trouble<WH06869> <FI>is<Fi> near<WH07138>; for <FI>there is<Fi> none to help<WH05826><WTH8802>. <RF>none...: Heb. not a helper<Rf>
Many<WH07227> bulls<WH06499> have compassed<WH05437><WTH8804> me: strong<WH047> <FI>bulls<Fi> of Bashan<WH01316> have beset me round<WH03803><WTH8765>.

They gaped<WH06475><WTH8804> upon me <FI>with<Fi> their mouths<WH06310>, <FI>as<Fi> a ravening<WH02963><WTH8802> and a roaring<WH07580><WTH8802> lion<WH0738>. <RF>gaped...: Heb. opened their mouths against me<Rf>

I am poured out<WH08210><WTH8738> like water<WH04325>, and all my bones<WH06106> are out of joint<WH06504><WTH8694>: my heart<WH03820> is like wax<WH01749>; it is melted<WH04549><WTH8738> in the midst<WH08432> of my bowels<WH04578>. <RF>out of...: or, sundered<Rf>

My strength<WH03581> is dried up<WH03001><WTH8804> like a potsherd<WH02789>; and my tongue<WH03956> cleaveth<WH01692><WTH8716> to my jaws<WH04455>; and thou hast brought<WH08239><WTH8799> me into the dust<WH06083> of death<WH04194>.

For dogs<WH03611> have compassed<WH05437><WTH8804> me: the assembly<WH05712> of the wicked<WH07489><WTH8688> have inclosed<WH05362><WTH8689> me: they pierced<WH03738><WTH8804><WTH8675><WH0738> my hands<WH03027> and my feet<WH07272>.
I may tell<WH05608><WTH8762> all my bones<WH06106>: they look<WH05027><WTH8686> <FI>and<Fi> stare<WH07200><WTH8799> upon me.
They part<WH02505><WTH8762> my garments<WH0899> among them, and cast<WH05307><WTH8686> lots<WH01486> upon my vesture<WH03830>.
But be not thou far<WH07368><WTH8799> from me, O LORD<WH03068>: O my strength<WH0360>, haste<WH02363><WTH8798> thee to help<WH05833> me.
Deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> my soul<WH05315> from the sword<WH02719>; my darling<WH03173> from the power<WH03027> of the dog<WH03611>. <RF>my darling: Heb. my only one<Rf> <RF>power: Heb. hand<Rf>
Save<WH03467><WTH8685> me from the lion's<WH0738> mouth<WH06310>: for thou hast heard<WH06030><WTH8804> me from the horns<WH07161> of the unicorns<WH07214>.<CM>
I will declare<WH05608><WTH8762> thy name<WH08034> unto my brethren<WH0251>: in the midst<WH08432> of the congregation<WH06951> will I praise<WH01984><WTH8762> thee.

Ye that fear<WH03373> the LORD<WH03068>, praise<WH01984><WTH8761> him; all ye the seed<WH02233> of Jacob<WH03290>, glorify<WH03513><WTH8761> him; and fear<WH01481><WTH8798> him, all ye the seed<WH02233> of Israel<WH03478>.

For he hath not despised<WH0959><WTH8804> nor abhorred<WH08262><WTH8765> the affliction<WH06039> of the afflicted<WH06041>; neither hath he hid<WH05641><WTH8689> his face<WH06440> from him; but when he cried<WH07768><WTH8763> unto him, he heard<WH08085><WTH8804>.
My praise<WH08416> <FI>shall be<Fi> of thee in the great<WH07227> congregation<WH06951>: I will pay<WH07999><WTH8762> my vows<WH05088> before them that fear<WH03373> him.

The meek<WH06035> shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> and be satisfied<WH07646><WTH8799>: they shall praise<WH01984><WTH8762> the LORD<WH03068> that seek<WH01875><WTH8802> him: your heart<WH03824> shall live<WH02421><WTH8799> for ever<WH05703>.

All the ends<WH0657> of the world<WH0776> shall remember<WH02142><WTH8799> and turn<WH07725><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068>: and all the kindreds<WH04940> of the nations<WH01471> shall worship<WH07812><WTH8691> before<WH06440> thee.
For the kingdom<WH04410> <FI>is<Fi> the LORD'S<WH03068>: and he <FI>is<Fi> the governor<WH04910><WTH8802> among the nations<WH01471>.

All <FI>they that be<Fi> fat<WH01879> upon earth<WH0776> shall eat<WH0398><WTH8804> and worship<WH07812><WTH8691>: all they that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> to the dust<WH06083> shall bow<WH03766><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him: and none can keep alive<WH02421><WTH8765> his own soul<WH05315>.
A seed<WH02233> shall serve<WH05647><WTH8799> him; it shall be accounted<WH05608><WTH8792> to the Lord<WH0136> for a generation<WH01755>.

They shall come<WH0935><WTH8799>, and shall declare<WH05046><WTH8686> his righteousness<WH06666> unto a people<WH05971> that shall be born<WH03205><WTH8737>, that he hath done<WH06213><WTH8804> <FI>this<Fi> .<CM>
